hero.headline: Building. Learning. Improving.
hero.description: I'm a Full-Stack Developer interested in creating useful and engaging web applications. I'm currently continuing to develop my skills through personal projects and my studies in software development.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Software Developer who took a slightly unconventional path into tech.

Before learning how to code, I worked in international business environments, where I learned how to communicate across teams, understand people's needs, and solve practical problems. Eventually, I developed a fascination in how technology could be used to actually build these solutions.

That curiosity led me to Le Wagon, where I trained in full-stack web development. After completing the bootcamp, I'm contuining to deepen my technical skills through Boston University's M.S. in Software Development while building projects of my own.
